profile.name: Harbor Lantern Tutoring Collective (sample)
profile.mission: Harbor Lantern helps students in grades 3-8 in Bridgeport become confident, on-grade-level readers and math learners through free small-group tutoring led by trained volunteers.
profile.programs: After-School Tutoring: groups of three students meet with a trained volunteer tutor twice a week for 90 minutes at two partner public elementary and middle schools, October through May. Summer Bridge: a five-week summer reading and math program for about 45 rising 4th-7th graders. Family Learning Nights: four evenings a year where families meet their child's tutor and take home learning kits in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
profile.population_served: About 140 students a year in grades 3-8 (ages 8-14) at two Bridgeport public schools. About 85% qualify for free or reduced-price school meals, and about 30% are multilingual learners, mostly from Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking families.
profile.funding_purpose: Recruit, train, and support 20 more volunteer tutors and add a third partner school, so 50 more students can be tutored in the 2027-28 school year.
profile.track_record: Founded in 2017; more than 900 students served in total. In the 2025-26 school year, 72% of students who attended at least 30 sessions gained one or more grade levels on the district's spring reading assessment, and 64% did so in math. 58 volunteer tutors gave about 4,100 hours, and 70% returned for a second year. Students attended 81% of scheduled sessions on average.
